title: Hacking your PC using your speaker without ever touching it
summary: A security research article demonstrating how speakers can be weaponized to hack PCs without physical access, potentially using acoustic signals or audio-based BadUSB attack techniques to inject malicious commands.
problem_solved: Exposes a novel hardware attack vector where audio output devices can be exploited to compromise computer systems remotely.
why_valuable: Critical security research that helps the cybersecurity community understand and defend against emerging acoustic-based attack techniques before they are widely weaponized.
